record.summary: Non-blocking conformance checks for the 003–005 authored protocol: warning codes, heuristics for lifecycle and execution hygiene, and a spec-lint tool that never substitutes for Feature 001 structural validation or registry truth. Amended by spec 128 (2026-05-02) to ratify the `--fail-on-warn` strict posture for OAP's CI invocation. Amended by spec 147 (2026-05-13) to register W-130/W-131/W-132 against the new kind-grammar surface and to add a registration-site `severity` field on Warning (warning/info tiers) per spec 128 §7. Info-tier diagnostics emit alongside warning-tier but are exempt from `--fail-on-warn`.
record.title: Conformance lint (optional workflow warnings)
